about: One row per field in the mod's own save file (Application.persistentDataPath/HangtimeOvertime.json, next to the game's save.json, which the mod never writes). Each row generates one field of OvertimeSave.

columns.verified: how it was seen in the written file, or 'no'

rows.written_when: an infinite run ends (lost a match): max(best, wins this run)
rows.verified: HangtimeOvertime.json showed bestInfiniteWins 1 after a 1-win run

rows.written_when: a new loop starts: max(best, loop)
